# Loom SDK

> Loom draws interactive graphs in WebGL2 and provides a headless, revision-checked graph editor.

These guides describe loom-core 0.1.0. The roadmap describes proposed additions.

## Product and examples

- [Loom Graph SDK: knowledge graph library for TypeScript](https://castlemilk.github.io/loom/index.md)
- [Loom artwork](https://castlemilk.github.io/loom/artwork/index.md)
- [Loom Graph Studio](https://castlemilk.github.io/loom/studio/index.md)
- [Around Canva: relationship cards](https://castlemilk.github.io/loom/studio/cards/index.md)
- [Wikispeedia: Wikipedia topic map](https://castlemilk.github.io/loom/studio/wikispeedia/index.md)
- [Node graph library for TypeScript](https://castlemilk.github.io/loom/node-graph/index.md)
- [Try a live OAuth graph query](https://castlemilk.github.io/loom/mcp/live/index.md)
- [Bauhaus Wikipedia graph](https://castlemilk.github.io/loom/examples/bauhaus/index.md)
- [Outer Solar System Wikipedia graph](https://castlemilk.github.io/loom/examples/outer-solar-system/index.md)
